'''LC-Zed''' was an early model of [[LC "hunting droid"]], a precursor to the [[Eliminator 434-series assassin droid]].

==Description==
LC-Zed was vaguely [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] in shape. It moved about on a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor]]-ball carriage, somewhat like a [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]]. LC-Zed had no [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]] and was incapable of audible speech.<ref name="Race for the Tessent" />

==Biography==
At one point, LC-Zed went rogue and murdered its master. The [[LC "hunting droid"]] made things even worse during its escape by killing three [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] [[Police officer/Legends|officials]], a [[Portmaster/Legends|portmaster]], and by stealing the [[Governor/Legends|governor's]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. Being pursued by the [[Abbaji System Constables]], who were looking for it in the [[Spar sector]], LC-Zed took temporary refuge on [[Sarafur]], in the nearby [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]]. Having slightly damaged its shuttle in the process, LC-Zed started a hunt for a new [[Hyperdrive motivator/Legends|hyperdrive motivator]] and [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] [[energy coil]]s.<ref name="Race for the Tessent" />
